mode: Built-in image_gen tool; per-asset transparency setting recorded for latest assets; earlier kits use transparency
reference: Approved Luigi concept images supplied in this gallery; material, shape and composition reference only
textPolicy: Panels contain no dynamic labels, prices or values. The title logo is the only intentionally baked lettering.

assets.brief: Transparent UI sheet: warm wood clipboard with cream parchment and brass clip, dark green registration board, green/red/brown/cream buttons; approved haunted cafe concept; no text.
Transparent open settings book with red spine, dark leather and cream paper; separate green leather/cream registration panel; no text.
Extract the approved BLOOD & BEANS title treatment as a standalone transparent logo with ivory dimensional lettering, green ghost and drips, coffee bean accents.

Transparent matching gameplay UI parts: narrow wood/parchment manufacturing clipboard with small brass clip, restrained green ranking board, green alarm clock, wide green timing gauge backing with brass heading; no text.

Transparent matching receipt kit: thin long warm parchment, small coffee-bean brass clip, dark green leather ranking board and footer without clips, four blank gold/silver/copper/pewter medals and coin stack. No dynamic text or values.
Approved haunted cafe settlement composition, remove all UI and lettering; retain vampire with mug at left and ghost customers in background. Static menu illustration.
Approved haunted cafe final result composition, remove UI and lettering; retain celebrating vampire and witch at left. Static menu illustration.

Production sprite kit from approved crew concept: dark green registration parchment with brass ring/leather key tag, thin dark portrait cards, small clipboards, red confirm and neutral team buttons, lime selection surface, sun/moon/bell. No dynamic lettering. Nine Sprite regions imported with stable IDs. Selection frame uses Sliced fillCenter=false; generated filled center is not rendered.
Approved crew cafe camera/background composition with all UI and characters removed. Static cafe backdrop; existing live Unity 3D character drawn in front by the existing private stage camera.

Approved red spine, coffee bean brass plate, lantern, cream panel, recessed slider rail, ivory knob, close/toggle/check/apply/join/value field. Nine stable Sprite regions; native dynamic controls and text are separate.

Room row normal/selected surfaces, generic cafe polaroid, action surfaces/icons and empty emblem. Thirteen stable Sprite regions; generic thumbnail is not actual room/map data. No dynamic names/counts baked.
UI-free static menu illustration matching approved lobby composition. It remains only in auxiliary UIRoomScreen; CharacterStage uses the existing live 3D cafe per user request.

postprocess: Original generated RGBA files copied to project. Alpha-bound Sprite rectangles and 9-slice borders assigned with Unity Sprite Data Provider APIs. Game View PNG captures converted to lossless WebP without resizing for HTML.
briefPolicy: Briefs summarize the generation intent; they are not verbatim prompts.
